subject: Multistakeholder intake: security runbook + scheduling for demo
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@finovate.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo request — next steps

Hi Samir — thanks for signing up and for the details on your trial usage. I'm the SDR on this account, looping in Avery (AE) and Connor (SE) to coordinate a short walkthrough and security pre-brief.

Two quick asks before we lock a slot:
- Can you share which timezone your CISO / security lead will prefer (IST or BST)?
- Do you have allowlist IPs / SSO provider name we should know about ahead of the demo?

Proposed 45-minute slots (your local IST):
- Tue 2026-10-13 10:30–11:15 IST (22:00–22:45 PDT)
- Wed 2026-10-14 16:00–16:45 IST (03:30–04:15 PDT)

If those don't work, tell us 2 windows and we'll convert across timezones. Attaching a short runbook we use for demos that require IT/security presence — covers minimal access, sample data, and SSO notes.

Attachments: demo-security-runbook.pdf (1 page stub)

Thanks — Jasmine
SDR, Redwood Inference
From: Samir Patel <samir@finovate.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T22:03:00+05:30
Subject: Re: Quick demo request — next steps

Hi Jasmine — great to meet you. Thanks for the runbook — that helps. A few clarifications from my side:
- We're based in India (IST). Our CISO (Priya Rao) is available only after 19:00 IST on weekdays.
- We use Okta for SSO and will need an IP allowlist for outbound calls to your hosted environment.
- IT would like a 15-min pre-call to validate connectivity and firewall rules; CISO wants to be on that pre-call where possible.

From our calendar, the earliest realistic demo slot with both product and security is:
- Thu 2026-10-15 20:00–20:45 IST (06:30–07:15 PDT) — this is when Priya can join.

I've attached a small CSV with our IT contacts and time constraints. If that slot's too late for your US folks, please propose 1–2 alternatives (we can push to Friday but prefer Thu).

Thanks — Samir
Product Manager, Finovate Financial
Attachments: finovate-it-availability.csv
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@finovate.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-13T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo request — next steps

Hi Samir — thanks for the details and for flagging Priya's availability. Quick note on conversions so we're aligned: Thu 2026-10-15 20:00 IST is Thu 2026-10-15 06:30 PDT / 09:30 EDT. That's early for us but doable — we can make it work.

I propose the following plan so we have coverage and avoid last-minute reschedules:
1) 15-min security pre-call with your IT + our SE + Soojin: Thu 2026-10-15 06:00 PDT (20:30 IST) — quick connectivity & allowlist check.
2) 45-min demo with AE + SE + CISO: Thu 2026-10-15 06:30 PDT (20:00 IST).

Connor — can you join both the pre-call and the demo? If not, suggest an alternate SE.
Soojin — can you confirm we'll be able to provide the public IPs to allowlist and whether Okta SSO flow requires any extra steps?

I'll create the calendar invites (separate pre-call and main demo) and include the HubSpot deal id in the description for your team. HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deal/FIN-2026-0543

If Thu looks tight we can offer Fri morning IST as a fallback; let me know.

— Avery
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>, Samir Patel <samir@finovate.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-13T11:20:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo request — next steps

Avery / team — I can cover both the 15-min pre-call and the main demo at the times you proposed. Quick notes for the pre-call so we can make the main demo productive:
- Please provision a temporary API key and sample logs for the demo environment (read-only).
- If you have firewall rules, please confirm either the IP range or that you accept mutual TLS; I'll adapt the demo.
- If Priya wants a short deck on data handling (retention, redaction), I can send a 2-slide summary ahead of time.

I've attached a short SE prep checklist we use for sensitive demos.

Attachments: se-prep-checklist.md

Looking forward to it — Connor
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Samir Patel <samir@finovate.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <prao@finovate.com>, security@finovate.com
Date: 2026-10-14T02:30:00+05:30
Subject: Re: Quick demo request — next steps

Thanks all — quick change: Priya (CISO) needs to be at a separate overlapping slot with more time to review export/retention details. She can do Fri 2026-10-16 19:30–20:15 IST (06:00–06:45 PDT) instead of Thu.

Options from our side:
- Option A: Keep Thu main demo (Avery/Connor) and schedule a follow-up deep-dive with Priya on Fri (preferred)
- Option B: Move the main demo to Fri 19:30 IST so Priya can attend live (this pushes your team later into the morning).

If you can do Option A, please send the Thu invite and we'll prioritize the Fri deep-dive for the CISO. If Option B is easier for Redwood, let us know and we'll confirm. Also attaching the IT contacts CSV again for your ops team.

Samir
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@finovate.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Rao <prao@finovate.com>
Date: 2026-10-14T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo request — next steps

Samir — thanks for the heads up and for giving options. Let's run with Option A to avoid a full reschedule of stakeholder calendars:
- Thu 2026-10-15 06:00 PDT / 20:30 IST — 15-min security pre-call (we'll confirm dial-in)
- Thu 2026-10-15 06:30 PDT / 20:00 IST — 45-min product demo (Avery + Connor)
- Fri 2026-10-16 06:00 PDT / 19:30 IST — 30–45 min deep-dive with Priya for CISO-level questions and retention/export review

I'll send calendar invites now and include the HubSpot deal link and meeting notes. Soojin will follow up with the public IPs for allowlisting and a 2-slide data-handling summary for Priya.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-demo-finovate-20261015

See you on the pre-call — Avery
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
